page.overview:
Who is Brad?

Brad is a CIA agent who appears briefly in the 1971 James Bond film Diamonds Are Forever. He is led by Felix Leiter.

He, Maxwell, and a third agent were sent to Circus Circus to keep an eye on Tiffany Case and the diamonds. The three followed Case into the Zambora sideshow and kept close watch on her while the attractive young woman underwent her "transformation." However, Tiffany was able to escape when Zambora, now a wild and dangerous gorilla, was released from her handler's control and broke out of her cage. Brad and Maxwell attempted to follow Tiffany when she fled past the "gorilla", but Case had already made her escape.

entity.description: Brad is a character who only appeared in [http://mortalkombat.wikia.com/wiki/Mortal_Kombat:_A_Novel Mortal Kombat: A Novel]. He was a young fighter of medium height, with brown hair and a goatee who participated in the Mortal Kombat tournament. Before the demonstration of things to come, Brad started a conversation with the other fighters at the dinner table. He asked them why they were participating in the tournament, wanting to know another reason that was not his own. A fighter sitting next to Ryan told him it was to defend Earthrealm. He recognized Ryan, who thought he wanted a fight, but Brad quickly apologized to him after questioning if he spent some time at Leavenworth, likely referring to the town in Washington State.
